name: grill
description: Grill your decisions: an outside AI judge from a different company than Claude argues the strongest case against a decision or forecast.
long_description:
Say **"grill this"** in any chat. Claude writes up the decision, shows it to you, and, once you approve, sends it to an outside judge: a model from a different company, reached through a model router with your own key.

The judge writes the strongest case for and against, names the cheapest test that would settle each challenge, and gives a verdict: holds, holds with conditions, weak, or refuted.

Every request goes to zero-data-retention endpoints only. A grill costs about a cent and takes 1–3 minutes.

tools.name: grill
tools.description: Send an approved decision, plan or forecast to an outside AI judge and get back a verdict, challenges and falsifiers.

tools.name: grill_result
tools.description: Collect a grill that was still running.

openrouter_api_key.title: Model router key (OpenRouter)
openrouter_api_key.description: Create one at https://openrouter.ai/keys and add a few dollars of credit; a grill costs about a cent. It is masked, stored securely, and sent only to OpenRouter. Have Grill Pro? Paste your managed key here instead. It is the same field.

jev_quality_check.title: Quality check with Jev
jev_quality_check.description: Score every grill with Jev, a zero-retention decision model reached through the same model router: are the falsifiers real tests, does the verdict fit the challenges? It sees the masked write-up and the report. About $0.0002 a grill. Claude tells you before each grill, and you can skip it for one. Turn off to send the write-up to the judge only.

judge_model.title: Judge model (optional)
judge_model.description: An OpenRouter model from a different company than the assistant you think with, such as google/gemini-2.5-pro. Leave blank to use Grill's default, which picks per request and keeps the author's company out. Grill Pro setup gives you one. An empty box is the same as blank.
